blocks.text: Fig. 15.14 mein lens ki convex (bahar ko ubhri hui) surface aik plane (bilkul seedhi, hamwar) glass plate ko chhoo rahi hai. Dono surfaces ke darmiyan hawa ki patli film ban jati hai. Is arrangement ko monochromatic (aik rang ki) roshni mein dekhein to circular (gol) interference fringes nazar aate hain (Fig. 15.15). Newton ne inhein study kiya tha, is liye inhein Newton's rings kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Plano-convex lens, seedhi surface oopar, plane glass plate par rakha aur centre par chhoota hua. Kinare ke qareeb aik ray neeche aati hai aur thickness t wali hawa ki patli film ke oopar aur neeche se reflect hui do rays aankh tak jati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.14: Glass plate se chhoota convex lens (kitab ki Figure 15.14 ke mutabiq hamara apna drawing).

blocks.alt: Gol view jis mein aik hi centre wale andhere aur roshan rings hain aur centre par andhera spot; centre se door rings qareeb qareeb hote jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.15: Circular (gol) interference fringes (kitab ki photo Figure 15.15 ke mutabiq hamara apna drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Centre par lens aur plate chhoote hain, is liye wahan hawa ki thickness zero hai; phir bhi centre andhera hai kyunke neeche wali surface se reflect hui wave half cycle ka phase shift le leti hai. Bahar ki taraf hawa ki film tezi se moti hoti hai, is liye rings qareeb qareeb aate hain.

Newton's rings tab bante hain jab plano-convex lens (aik taraf seedha, doosri taraf ubhra hua lens) plane glass plate par rakha jaye aur dono ke darmiyan hawa ki patli film ban jaye. Monochromatic source (jaise sodium lamp) ki roshni is hawa ki film ki oopar aur neeche dono surfaces se reflect hoti hai. Reflected rays, apne path difference aur phase shift ke mutabiq, constructive interference (roshan rings) ya destructive interference (andhere rings) karti hain. Newton's rings se monochromatic roshni ki wavelength nikali ja sakti hai, lens ka radius of curvature (lens ki golai ka radius) maloom kiya ja sakta hai, aur precision optics (bohat bareek optical kaam) mein surface ki irregularities (kharabiyan, ooch neech) pakri jati hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Lens ke centre se barabar faasle par hawa ki film ki thickness barabar hoti hai, is liye fringes circles (rings) ki shakal mein bante hain.

blocks.prompt: Newton's rings ka centre (beech wala point) andhera kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Contact ke point par hawa ki film ki thickness taqreeban zero hai, is liye path difference nahi; lekin glass plate se (hawa se glass par) reflect hone wali wave half cycle ka phase shift leti hai. Is liye dono reflected waves aadha cycle out of phase ho kar aik doosre ko khatam kar deti hain.

items: Newton's rings: plano-convex lens aur plane glass plate ke darmiyan hawa ki film se gol fringes.
Roshan rings constructive, andhere rings destructive interference; path difference aur phase shift par depend karte hain.
Istemal: wavelength, lens ka radius of curvature, surface ki irregularities.
